audit_type: assistant source-context review; not independent human adjudication or registered precision proof
sample: k2_audit_sample_strict.csv data rows 51 through 100 in frozen CSV order
method: Read selected records and surrounding stored full-text context. Additional within-source passages examined for rows 51, 59, 85, 98 and 100. No external primary cited studies reopened, no sampling or statistical computation. Exact quote presence establishes attribution only. Judgments assess extraction fidelity separately from scientific validity and actionable scope.
permission_boundary: Conditional candidates are review priorities, not approved numeric priors or implemented actions. None receives automatic eligibility; molecule/site mapping, source exclusions and primary evidence review remain required.
failure_modes: Direction reversal by confusing exocyclic and endocyclic bond angles (53).
Faithful quote with wrong endpoint: RNA degradation versus peptide proteolysis (89), cell adhesion/cytotoxicity versus direct affinity (75,80,92), serum exposure versus oral bioavailability (82).
Quote does not support the extracted claim, even when related support exists elsewhere (51,59,100).
Research-article background citations elevated to primary evidence (55,67,69).
Method descriptions and qualitative cautions mislabeled no_effect or signed outcomes (71,73,79,81,87,93,94,95,97).
Specific scaffold/target/assay results generalized to all cyclic peptides (60,61,64,83,88,91).
Selection strategy promoted to proven causal improvement without a comparator (96).
Partial inhibition and inferential mechanism flattened into categorical claims (98).

strongest_conditional_candidates.why: Explicit loop-length comparison in the CP9/CP12 influenza-HA series; preserve coupled sequence changes and neutralization endpoint.
Series-1 depsipeptide cyclization comparison preserves the critical series restriction and matched lipophilicity.
Matched linear/cyclic accumulation comparison in defined mycobacterial assay and compositions; cannot transfer to mammalian permeability.
Named RGD STEMtide/linear adhesion comparisons; preserve D-Phe and closure chemistry, correct endpoint.
Specific Sortase/staple failure mode with monomer versus dimer outcome; preserve uncertainty and substrate motif.
Concrete imidazole-PEG action on RNA binders, but only after correcting the wholly wrong proteolytic-stability label.

records.source_title: Food-derived linear vs. rationally designed cyclic peptides as potent TNF-alpha inhibitors: an integrative computational study.
records.rationale: The saved quotation attributes cell-penetrating potential to earlier work; nearby text discusses modeled stabilization. It does not validate a universal increase in conformational stability or chameleonicity.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Restrict to the modeled TNFR1-derived analogues; separate geometry from permeability and primary observations from cited rationale.

records.source_title: Artificial Intelligence for Therapeutic Peptide Discovery and Development
records.rationale: The review explicitly lists reduced solubility as one possible adverse consequence of macrocyclization alongside alternative conformations.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retain a solubility check when closing a peptide; do not apply an unconditional negative solubility weight.

records.source_title: Macrocyclic geminal diols: synthesis, structures, stability and photophysical properties.
records.rationale: The smaller [2]PCP has the larger exocyclic O-C-O angle, 111.74 versus 110.55 degrees. The extraction appears to confuse it with the endocyclic angle, which decreases. These are nonpeptidic cyclophanes.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: No peptide intervention; correct the angle identity and sign in a separate chemistry record.

records.source_title: Rational Design and Delivery of Engineered Peptides: Toward a Unified Framework for Structure, Screening, and Application.
records.rationale: The review describes lipidation and terminal capping as steric or end-group protection strategies, but does not establish a universal effect or a matched cyclic-peptide series here.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Consider only accessible termini or validated conjugation sites with an appropriate protease assay; a head-to-tail peptide has no free termini to cap.

records.source_title: Design, Pharmacological Characterization, and Molecular Docking of Minimalist Peptidomimetic Antagonists of α<sub>4</sub>β<sub>1</sub> Integrin.
records.rationale: The passage explicitly identifies DS-70 as a linear alpha/beta hybrid and cites previous serum-stability and in-vivo work. It is not a macrocyclization result from this paper.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retrieve the DS-70 primary studies before considering beta-Pro substitutions; do not transfer its direction to cyclic LDV agonists.

records.source_title: Stimuli-Responsive Biomimetic Nanomedicines for Targeted Therapy in Ischemic Stroke: Design Principles, Preclinical Evidence and Translational Challenges.
records.rationale: The cited system uses surface-conjugated cRGD on PEGylated tPA vesicles for activated-platelet targeting. This supports a delivery configuration, not a quantified intrinsic-affinity increase.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Test cRGD surface presentation only for platelet-integrin targeting with conjugation density and off-target binding controls.

records.source_title: Massive barcode-free chemical screenings enable the discovery of bioactive macrocycles with passive membrane permeability.
records.rationale: CycloSEL selection followed by subsequent chemical modifications yielded a permeable WDR5 macrocycle. The platform itself is not an intervention proven to increase permeability.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Use as a workflow/campaign card; recover the specific optimization edits separately.

records.source_title: Rational Design and Delivery of Engineered Peptides: Toward a Unified Framework for Structure, Screening, and Application.
records.rationale: This is the same review paragraph as row 54: steric shielding and end protection are mechanistic design options, not independent evidence or a generic descriptor effect.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Merge evidence-family identity with row 54; preserve terminal accessibility and protease-specific conditions.

records.source_title: Head-to-Tail Cyclization and D-Amino Acid Substitution Redesign the Biological Activities of a Naturally Occurring Amphibian Peptide.
records.rationale: The saved quote concerns RDKit rotatable-bond counting, not TPSA. Elsewhere the paper reports a TPSA decrease for the Hp-1891 head-to-tail pair, with terminal chemistry changed.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Re-anchor to the descriptor comparison near character 11277/Table 2 and restrict to this covalent transformation; no experimental permeability claim follows.

records.source_title: BamA as a next-generation antibacterial target: mechanistic insights, inhibitor landscape, and rational drug design strategies
records.rationale: The paragraph concerns crosslinked darobactins mimicking a beta strand at BamA. It does not establish that more rigidity improves affinity across macrocyclic peptides.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Preserve the darobactin beta-strand geometry and crosslink topology when designing BamA analogues; review target-specific SAR before edits.

records.source_title: Discovery of Highly Selective Noncovalent Macrocyclic Peptide Inhibitors Suppressing Both TMPRSS2 Protease Activity and Viral Receptor Function.
records.rationale: The study reports engineered TMPRSS2 lead derivatives with better proteolytic stability and affinities; the general statement omits the lead identity and actual edits.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retrieve and map the tested lead-to-derivative edits before applying them to the same TMPRSS2 scaffold.

records.source_title: Rational Design and Delivery of Engineered Peptides: Toward a Unified Framework for Structure, Screening, and Application.
records.rationale: The review links hydrocarbon bridges between olefin-bearing residues to helical stabilization and reduced proteolysis; uptake is a separate possible outcome.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Consider a geometry-compatible staple in an alpha-helical peptide and test proteolysis plus solubility; not a universal extra-ring reward.

records.source_title: Food-derived linear vs. rationally designed cyclic peptides as potent TNF-alpha inhibitors: an integrative computational study.
records.rationale: The source states this preorganization rationale for head-to-tail redesign, but the excerpt does not measure binding entropy or experimentally show an affinity gain.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retain as a modeling hypothesis for the named TNFR1-derived analogue; no numeric affinity prior.

records.source_title: Interleukin-17 in disease pathogenesis and therapy: recent advances in targeted drug design and medicinal chemistry.
records.rationale: The review describes promising IL-17RB/MLK4-disrupting cyclic candidates in preclinical work. The extraction drops the pathway and prospective clinical qualification.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Restrict to MLK4-interface loop mimetics; do not infer general tumor selectivity or clinical efficacy.

records.source_title: V<sub>H</sub>H antibody loop guides design of a synthetic macrocyclic peptide that potently blocks influenza virus membrane fusion.
records.rationale: The paper explicitly compares 15-residue CP9 with 13-residue CP12 in the cysteine-containing influenza-HA series and reports reduced binding and neutralization on shortening.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Avoid transferring a two-residue shortening into this antibody-loop mimic without re-testing HA binding and neutralization; map accompanying sequence changes before claiming ring size alone causes the effect.

records.source_title: Selection of Nucleotide-Encoded Mass Libraries of Macrocyclic Peptides for Inaccessible Drug Targets.
records.rationale: The review says staples can be designed to enhance permeability, rigidity or protection; it does not say that every staple does all three.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Use only scaffold- and staple-specific primary evidence to select a permeability intervention; compare an otherwise matched unstapled control.

records.source_title: Sortase-mediated generation of various macrocyclic peptide scaffolds from low-reactivity electrophilic substrates.
records.rationale: The introductory passage cites thioether frameworks as useful scaffolds for oral-peptide discovery. This is not an oral-bioavailability measurement or an increase caused by crosslinking in the current synthesis study.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retrieve the cited oral-platform studies and separate synthesis compatibility from oral exposure.

records.source_title: Engineering Protease-Resistant Peptides via Non-Canonical Amino Acids: Design Strategies and Biosynthetic Advances.
records.rationale: The review says many ncAAs can confer resistance; nearby discussion also uses protease-cleavable ncAA linkers. The extraction loses the identity and protease context.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Specify residue, position, protease and required cleavage behavior before a stability edit.

records.source_title: De novo design of a macrocycle-induced dimerization system for cellular control.
records.rationale: MC1 has two cis amides, but the source only cites an association with permeability and calls these designs likely permeable. Cis content is not an experimentally isolated causal intervention here.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retain MC1 conformational context; require a matched cis/trans series before rewarding cis amides.

records.source_title: Cyclic Thiosulfinates: Synthesis and Applications in Chemical Biology and Materials Science.
records.rationale: This summary describes cyclic thiosulfinate heterocycles and their broad applications, not a cyclic-peptide property relationship.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Keep only in a separate linker-chemistry reference collection if an explicit peptide application is identified.

records.source_title: Mirror-Peptidizer: In Silico Mirror-Image Screening Enables De Novo Design of D-Peptide Binders without D-Protein Synthesis.
records.rationale: HSQC and mutagenesis support an MDM2-binding interface for designed D-peptides. No null comparison or macrocyclic topology is established by this record.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Use a target-interface validation card; reclassify direction as descriptive rather than no effect.

records.source_title: Interleukin-17 in disease pathogenesis and therapy: recent advances in targeted drug design and medicinal chemistry.
records.rationale: The source warns of residual degradation and short half-life despite cyclization. This does not show that cyclization decreases stability.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retain as a development caution for these candidates, with no signed transformation effect.

records.source_title: Influence of Macrocyclization Strategies on DNA-Encoded Cyclic Peptide Libraries.
records.rationale: Eight libraries share building blocks but differ in disulfide versus electrophilic crosslinking. This is a design description, not evidence of no synthesis effect.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Use the matched-library design as a protocol template; treat differing closure classes as separate experimental factors.

records.source_title: Next-Generation Antimicrobial Peptides for Biofilm-Associated Infections: Engineering, Biomaterial Delivery and AI-Assisted Discovery.
records.rationale: The review categorizes D-substitution as a proteolytic-stability strategy while explicitly listing potency, toxicity and selectivity tradeoffs. General metabolic stability is broader.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Consider position-specific D substitutions only with proteolysis and activity controls in the intended AMP scaffold.

records.source_title: Chemoselective sulfonyl fluoride exchange (SuFEx)-induced macrocyclization of tyrosine-containing peptides in aqueous media.
records.rationale: The RGD STEMtides generally inhibit adhesion more than their linear comparators; D-Phe also changes activity and small differences within cyclic analogues matter. Direct binding constants are not this endpoint.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Compare the specified SuFEx-cyclized RGD/RGDfY pairs at matched D-Phe content using cell-adhesion and receptor-specific assays.

records.source_title: Exploring Macrocyclic Chemical Space: Strategies and Technologies for Drug Discovery.
records.rationale: The review reports 4-methylquinoline outperforming alternatives in a particular palladium-mediated C-H macrocyclization. The feature is catalyst/ligand choice, not peptide charge or polarity.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Use as a reaction-planning candidate only for the matching Pd/substrate system after checking the primary protocol.

records.source_title: End-to-End Backbone Cyclization Enhances Passive Permeability of bRo5 Oligomeric Depsipeptides with Nonlinear Size Dependence.
records.rationale: The paper explicitly reports uniform cyclization benefit in depsipeptide series 1 and nonuniform size-dependent benefits in series 2. The extraction retains series 1, which is essential.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Test end-to-end cyclization within the defined series-1 backbone and matched side-chain lipophilicity; preserve assay and size range.

records.source_title: The Synergy of Macrocycles and Heterocycles: A Review of Coordination Behavior, Sensing, and Functional Materials Based on Calixarenes.
records.rationale: The source lists cone and alternate calixarene conformations among structural factors governing heterocycle presentation. These calixarenes are not peptide rings.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: No cyclic-peptide action from this entry.

records.source_title: Food-derived linear vs. rationally designed cyclic peptides as potent TNF-alpha inhibitors: an integrative computational study.
records.rationale: The modeled disulfide analogue has acceptable Ramachandran geometry. This is neither a measured no-effect result nor evidence of solvent-dependent chameleonicity.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retain as model-quality metadata, not a conformational or permeability reward.

records.source_title: Gold- and Platinum-Peptide Bioconjugates in Cancer Therapy: Recent Advances and Future Directions.
records.rationale: The review attributes a cyclic Au(III)-RGD conjugate cytotoxicity advantage to targeting and uptake. The endpoint and proposed mechanism do not establish direct integrin-affinity change.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Consider matched linear/cyclic versions of the same gold conjugate with uptake, integrin dependence and toxicity controls.

records.source_title: RingKin: portraying the vast macrocyclic chemical universe surrounding kinase drugs.
records.rationale: RingKin reports predicted retention within 0.5 log units for small-molecule kinase derivatives. Retention is not a statistical no-effect result and does not establish peptide binding.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Keep as a separate small-molecule computational benchmark card.

records.source_title: Phage Display as a Promising Platform for Peptide Drug Discovery.
records.rationale: The review links D-peptide protease resistance to serum circulation and general bioavailability, not specifically oral absorption.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Reclassify to proteolytic/serum stability; do not use an oral-bioavailability reward.

records.source_title: Systematic Determination of the Impact of Structural Edits on Peptide Accumulation into Mycobacteria.
records.rationale: PAC-MAN detects apparent mycomembrane accumulation in Msm and Mtb across matched leucine/serine linear and cyclic series. This is not mammalian passive permeability.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Test the corresponding ring-closure edits for mycobacterial accumulation with size and composition controlled; preserve organism and assay.

records.source_title: Predictive machine learning models for rational permeability design in de novo macrocycle engineering: a review.
records.rationale: The review discusses low yields, dilution and stereochemical difficulty. The direction increases is interpretable only for difficulty, not synthesis success.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Use a synthesis-risk flag and route-specific feasibility check, not a positive macrocyclization score.

records.source_title: Macrocyclic Phage Display for Identification of Selective Protease Substrates.
records.rationale: The paper develops selective FAPalpha/DPP4 macrocyclic substrates, but the quoted general benefit is introductory and citation-supported. Selection and optimization also contribute; cyclization alone is not isolated here.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retrieve exact linker/sequence comparisons and protease turnover data before a FAPalpha-versus-DPP4 substrate edit.

records.source_title: Tangled Tail of Mechanically Interlocked Peptides.
records.rationale: The review reports Phe-derived chiral auxiliaries in active-template CuAAC rotaxane synthesis, with high diastereoselectivity. It is not peptide affinity or permeability SAR.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Use only for a matching mechanically interlocked synthesis task after primary-method verification.

records.source_title: Structure-Guided Design of Cyclic Peptide: A Potent Inhibitor Targeting PD-1/PD-L1 Axis with Antitumor Activity.
records.rationale: The passage specifies MM-PBSA as a calculation method. It reports neither an affinity effect nor an experimentally validated binding-free-energy comparison.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Store as a computational-method card, not a biological rule.

records.source_title: Interleukin-17 in disease pathogenesis and therapy: recent advances in targeted drug design and medicinal chemistry.
records.rationale: The review concerns IL-17RB-loop-derived MLK4 disruptors and their linear precursors. The extraction drops the sequence/pathway restriction and conflates cellular persistence with general metabolism.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retrieve the Hu et al. primary pair and test its closure topology within that scaffold; retain uptake and persistence as separate endpoints.

records.source_title: Discovery of Macrocyclic Peptide Binders, Covalent Modifiers, and Degraders of a Structured RNA by mRNA Display.
records.rationale: The imidazole-PEG attachment gives RNA-targeted macrocycles proximity-dependent RNA degradation in vitro. It says nothing about proteolytic stability of the peptide.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: After reclassifying to RNA degradation, consider the tag only on validated SNCA IRE binders with off-target RNA and tag-only controls.

records.source_title: Exploring Macrocyclic Chemical Space: Strategies and Technologies for Drug Discovery.
records.rationale: The review explicitly states scaffold-dependent decreases or minor gains in permeability after cyclization.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retain opposing evidence when proposing closure; require matched scaffold-specific permeability tests.

records.source_title: Macrocyclization of native peptides through (thio)urea crosslinking of two amines.
records.rationale: The conclusion refers to the tested single/dual (thio)urea-bridged peptides, not every macrocyclization. Biological measurements are distinguished from docking interpretation.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Map the original amine pairs and linear controls before testing the same (thio)urea bridge for stability.

records.source_title: Gold- and Platinum-Peptide Bioconjugates in Cancer Therapy: Recent Advances and Future Directions.
records.rationale: Only the polyarginine Pt(IV) conjugate 4a modestly improved HepG2 activity; adding polyglutamate abolished it. Neither D stereochemistry nor binding affinity is the tested factor.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Reclassify to charge-dependent conjugate uptake/activity and preserve the 4a/4b counterexample.

records.source_title: Benchmarking AI-driven protocols for cyclic peptide conformer prediction and ranking
records.rationale: The observation is confined to tested even-length peptides, with data not shown and acknowledged small-sample/sampling limitations.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retain an ensemble-sampling hypothesis about opposed turns; no universal turn-shift rule or null effect.

records.source_title: Artificial Intelligence for Therapeutic Peptide Discovery and Development
records.rationale: The review warns that closing an otherwise favorable linear sequence may create strain or incompatible geometry. This is a risk statement, not no effect.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Require closure-site and ensemble feasibility checks; do not assume syntactic validity implies realizable conformations.

records.source_title: Mirror-Peptidizer: In Silico Mirror-Image Screening Enables De Novo Design of D-Peptide Binders without D-Protein Synthesis.
records.rationale: The source relates MBDP-1 helicity to the MDM2 groove and contrasts other target topologies. No cyclic topology or null effect is shown.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Use target-shape context for D-peptide design, preserving the specific model and interface validation.

records.source_title: Accurate de novo design of high-affinity protein-binding macrocycles using deep learning.
records.rationale: The paper clustered 335 designs and selected 13 diverse representatives to reduce experimental burden. It does not compare this choice with an alternative selection strategy or measure increased hit probability.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Retain diversity-based selection as an explicit experimental strategy; test it against a matched selection baseline before claiming benefit.

records.source_title: From Concepts to Inhibitors: A Blueprint for Targeting Protein-Protein Interactions.
records.rationale: The review describes often-poor oral bioavailability and permeability as development barriers, without a transformation or comparison.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Use as an endpoint checklist, not a negative effect assigned to every cyclic peptide.

records.source_title: Helicity-Dependent Enzymatic Peptide Cyclization.
records.rationale: The i,i+7 substrate still forms cyclic dimers; extra products suggest monomer inhibition and only some dimer inhibition. The source labels oligomerization presumptive.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: For LPETG-containing substrates of the engineered Sortase, compare staple geometry and quantify monomer/dimer/oligomer fractions; preserve partial and tentative wording.

records.source_title: Linking molecular architecture to antibacterial functions: a chemical biology view of cyclic depsipeptides.
records.rationale: The review broadly attributes increased lipophilicity and permeability to amide-to-ester replacement, citing older work. It provides no matched, position-specific pair in this excerpt.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Treat an amide-to-ester edit as a scoped hypothesis after checking original evidence, conformation and hydrolytic stability; not a global ester-count reward.

records.source_title: Goldilocks-Inspired Design of Mid-Size Macrocycles for Selective Targeting of Human Melanocortin Receptors.
records.rationale: The stored quotation only concerns previously reported 19-membered ligands. The paper later finds ring contraction generally lowers potency, while certain 20-membered Pro6 analogues retain MC4R activity and lose MC3R activity.
records.conditional_intervention_or_repair: Re-anchor to subtype-resolved results near character 31664 and distinguish 19 from 20 rings, potency from agonism, and selectivity tradeoffs.
